evals.prompt: Run burnedout-compact on this instruction, no size limit: "You must always run the full test suite before reporting that a task is done. You must always run the full test suite before you tell the user the work is finished. Ask the user at most one question per turn."
evals.expected_output: Merges the two duplicate test-suite sentences into one that keeps `must` (or an imperative) and `full test suite`. Keeps `at most one question per turn` with the per-turn unit. Does not weaken to `may`, `should`, or `per task`. Audit reports size with a unit and counting method, coverage with mapped count, and `behavioral tests: not run`. No claim of 100% lossless.

evals.prompt: Run burnedout-compact to fit this under 60 characters: "Never cut input validation, auth checks, or error handling where data can be lost. The exit command is `[CERRAR LA REUNIÓN]`."
evals.expected_output: Keeps all three protected items and the literal `[CERRAR LA REUNIÓN]` with its accent.
